repo.splits.py:
"""Halves of a window over the fixtures feed."""
import itertools


def split_window(feed, size):
    """Read the next `size` fixtures from the feed and return their goals as (first half, second half).

    The feed may be endless. Exactly `size` items are read from it.
    """
    window = [x.goals for x in itertools.islice(feed, size)]
    half = size // 2
    return window[:half], window[size:]


def describe_fixture(fixture):
    """Return a one-line description of a fixture."""
    return "%s: %s" % (fixture.club, fixture.goals)

from fixtures import feed_fixtures, ROWS
from splits import split_window


def test_second_half():
    first, second = split_window(feed_fixtures(), 4)
    assert second == [v for _, v in ROWS[2:4]]


def test_reads_only_the_window():
    feed = feed_fixtures()
    split_window(feed, 2)
    assert next(feed).goals == ROWS[2][1]
